name: Border beam
summary: Animated rainbow glow that rides the border of any card, button or input; installable as the border-beam npm package.
description: A React component that renders an animated beam along the border of cards, buttons and inputs, with a React Native port (border-beam-native) that is not on npm yet and uses a Metal shader. The original site beam.jakubantalik.com is now a move notice pointing to libraries.dev/beam, which carries the playground, installation and usage; the npm package border-beam is unchanged.
contains: animated rainbow beam riding the border of cards, buttons and inputs
distributed as the border-beam npm package
React Native port not on npm yet; Metal shader built through Xcode
interactive playground, installation and usage on the new home
original domain now redirects to libraries.dev/beam
